channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Allan Houston | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Allan Houston from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grant Hill on Allan Houston, Lindsey Hunter
item.description:
Hill revealed in a recent podcast interview.

“Detroit, you know, they were in a bit of transition. They drafted the year before Lindsey Hunter and Allan Houston at the point guard and shooting guard positions. So I thought I could slide right in at the pa at the small forward position and play along those guys and, kind of build with them.”

Grant Hill on Allan Houston, Lindsey Hunter, Dec 25, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Marcus Camby on Allan Houston, Glen Grunwald
item.description:
Nate Taylor:More of the source close to Camby:

“Glen Grunwald & Allan Houston played a big role. He has a tremendous amount of respect for both.”

Marcus Camby on Allan Houston, Glen Grunwald, Jul 10, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: John Jenkins on Allan Houston, Reggie Miller
item.description:
(John) Jenkins said in reference to player comparisons.

“Reggie Miller and Allan Houston, those are two guys from back in the day that I look up to.”

John Jenkins on Allan Houston, Reggie Miller, Jun 15, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.
